description: This Java class 'NameAndOffset' models an entity with a name and x,y offset coordinates, providing parsing capabilities from a string.

classes.name: NameAndOffset
classes.description: A data holder class representing a name and its associated x and y offsets, with a static parser method.

methods.name: parseNameAndOffset
methods.description: Parses a string request into a NameAndOffset instance, interpreting the string as a name optionally followed by two numeric offsets.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name stored in this NameAndOffset instance.
